title: Adult doesn't understand what they mean

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi explains something important to a parent, but the parent misunderstands.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi starts wondering whether something is wrong with the way they communicate.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'That's not what I meant!' Kavi tries again. But somehow the words keep landing differently from what Kavi intended.

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi makes a mistake and a parent reacts angrily.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The parent's anger makes Kavi feel ashamed.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi begins to confuse being corrected with being unloved.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi hears the sharp voice and looks down at the floor. The mistake was small, but the feeling in Kavi's chest is enormous.

title: Not invited to a birthday party

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi discovers that several classmates are going to a birthday party and Kavi wasn't invited.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The party invitation has already been decided.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi starts turning one missing invitation into a judgment about their worth.
context: school or a conversation among classmates
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi hears everyone talking about Saturday's birthday party. Then comes the realization: everyone is going—except Kavi.

title: Close friend moved to another city

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi's closest friend moves to another city.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: They can no longer meet and play every day.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi fears distance means the friendship is ending.
context: final day together or first days after the move
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The moving boxes are packed. Kavi's friend is leaving, and suddenly the walk to school will have one missing person in it.

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi discovers that classmates have a group chat that Kavi isn't part of.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel included and understand what happened.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Seeing the conversation happening without them makes Kavi feel unimportant.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi's friends are laughing about messages on their phones. Kavi looks at the screen and realizes there is a conversation happening that Kavi isn't part of.

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi notices a new pimple before going to school.
storySeed.immediateWant: Hide it or stop worrying about how others will see them.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot instantly change their skin.
storySeed.emotionalTension: One tiny spot suddenly feels like the biggest thing everyone will notice.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi leans toward the mirror. There it is—a tiny new spot that somehow feels enormous.

title: Reprimanded in front of friends or guests

storySeed.childExperience: A parent or teacher corrects Kavi sharply while friends or guests are watching.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The embarrassing moment is happening publicly.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels that being corrected has made them smaller in everyone's eyes.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi makes a small mistake. The correction comes quickly—and so does the uncomfortable feeling of everyone watching.

title: Best friend is playing with someone else

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi arrives at the playground expecting to play with their best friend, but finds the friend already deep in a game with another child.
storySeed.immediateWant: Join the game and get their friend's attention.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The game is already underway and Kavi doesn't know whether there is room for them.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi starts wondering whether their friend would rather play with someone else.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi spots their best friend near the climbing frame. They hurry over—then slow down when they see who is already playing beside them.
storySeed.note: Distinct engine from SIT042 (missing connection/disappointment) — this is replacement/exclusion/jealousy.

title: Wishing they had someone else's hair

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi notices a friend's hair and wishes their own hair looked the same.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi's own hair has a different texture, shape, or appearance.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi starts seeing their own appearance through comparison instead of accepting it as their own.
context: getting ready for school or seeing classmates
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi watches the friend's hair bounce as they walk. Later, Kavi looks in the mirror and tries to make their own hair do the same thing.

title: Pressure to always 'be good' and behave

storySeed.childExperience: Before an important family or school event, Kavi is told repeatedly not to make a mistake.
storySeed.immediateWant: Get through the event without making a mistake.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot control every impulse, feeling, or small accident.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Trying so hard to behave makes Kavi increasingly worried about doing anything wrong.
context: family gathering, school event, or formal occasion
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'Remember to be good,' Mama whispers before they walk in. Kavi nods. Suddenly even sitting still feels like a test.
storySeed.note: REVISED per locked decision — converted from a vague ongoing parenting dynamic into a specific pre-event scene.

title: Moving to a new home or city

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is preparing to leave a familiar home and move to a new place.
storySeed.immediateWant: Hold on to the familiar parts of home.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The move means leaving behind familiar rooms, places, routines, or people.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels excited about what is coming but sad about what is being left behind.
context: days before or during a family move
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi walks through the nearly empty bedroom one last time. The walls are the same, but without the furniture the room already feels different.

title: Moving abroad (very relevant for NRI families)

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi learns that the family is moving to another country, far from the places and people Kavi knows.
storySeed.immediateWant: Hold on to home and familiar connections.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The distance means many familiar things will change.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Excitement about a new country sits beside worry about leaving life behind.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The suitcase lies open on the floor. Kavi folds a favourite shirt inside and wonders how far away 'home' can travel.

title: Noticing a new change in their body

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi notices a new physical change in their body that they did not expect.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand what is happening and know that they are okay.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The change is unfamiliar and Kavi does not yet understand it.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Something happening inside Kavi's own body suddenly feels strange and unsettling.
context: at home, e.g. brushing teeth, getting dressed, bedtime
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi notices something different and pauses. It wasn't there before. Kavi looks again, wondering what is happening.
storySeed.note: Original bundle (tooth loss + growing pains + puberty) deliberately un-bundled. Needs age-routing at generation time — do not treat puberty as generic 5-12 content.

title: Feels guilty for not including someone in play

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi realises that another child was left out while Kavi and the others were playing.
storySeed.immediateWant: Make the other child feel included.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The game is already underway and Kavi is unsure how to bring the child in without disrupting it.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels guilty because they noticed the exclusion but did not act sooner.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi looks across the playground and notices the child standing alone. A moment ago Kavi hadn't thought much about it. Now Kavi can't stop noticing.

title: Best friend makes a new best friend

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi's closest friend starts spending much of their time with a new friend.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot control who else their friend chooses to spend time with.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi begins interpreting the new friendship as evidence that they are being replaced.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi used to know exactly where to find their best friend at recess. Lately, someone else is always standing there first.

title: Accidentally left out of a game

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi arrives while other children are already playing and realises they have not been included.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The game is already underway and nobody has invited Kavi in.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi is unsure whether to ask to join or walk away before anyone can reject them.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi walks toward the group, then slows down. Everyone is already playing. Nobody looks up.
